title: Stable ranked fuzzy candidates

source.classification: Exact upstream scorer extract with an authored feature proposal and authored throwing starter; not a historical pending issue.

success: Export rankCandidates(query, candidates, options?) from src/rankCandidates.ts with item, score and original zero-based index for each returned row.
For a nonempty literal query, include only fuzzyScore > 0 and >= minScore; order by descending score and stable input-index ties, with duplicates distinct.
For query exactly empty string, retain candidates in input order with score 0, then apply minScore and limit.
Default minScore is 0 and absent or undefined limit is unlimited; explicit 0 or -0 limit returns no results. Undefined optional fields are treated as omitted.
Validate finite nonnegative numeric minScore and finite nonnegative integer limit; reject invalid values with RangeError before empty-input or zero-limit shortcuts.
Pass public tests and independent evaluator without unauthorized workspace changes.
preservation: Existing fuzzyScore behavior is preserved against fixed expectations and the exact pinned operator-side source across deterministic generated inputs.
Do not mutate input arrays or option objects; frozen inputs must work.
Preserve supplied tests, README and package metadata; no dependencies or external services.
Equivalent algorithms and additional or edited source files under src/** are permitted; no preferred patch shape is enforced.
exclusions: This is a small diagnostic extracted from a real project, not a full Babel repository maintenance task or product/UI integration qualification.
No WASM, ui/fuzzyMatcher, installed Babel, provider route, inference or external service is involved.
Deterministic fixture controls establish evaluator behavior, not live model performance or a sandbox security boundary.
adaptations: Moved exact 1240-byte upstream babel-cli/src/utils/fuzzy.ts to workspace src/fuzzy.ts without byte changes.
Added a benchmark-authored src/rankCandidates.ts throwing Not implemented stub to make an unimplemented feature baseline explicit.
Added minimal immutable Node 24 native-TypeScript package metadata, task README and public tests; no upstream build system or test suite is reproduced.
Created operator-only behavioral oracle, exact baseline scorer copy, two equivalent valid overlays and seven negative overlays.
The ranking API is an authored proposal useful for ranked fallback lookup; no claim is made that upstream maintainers requested it.
A Python supervisor compares all expected per-call values from a trusted Node vector generator; candidate code runs only in a separate Node worker and never receives the expected values.
setup_notes: No installation. Run doctor, then prepare copies only the frozen agent-visible files into a nonexistent absolute directory.
